decisions.reason: Uses ls-remote-tags.txt absence of v0.9.5 plus sync-script.sh pushing only HEAD:main to explain attempt-1 resolution failure as a tag-distribution defect, not network/typo/npm guesses.

Combines dsh-version.txt (0.1.1-rc.2) with compat-table (v0.9.7 targets 0.1.2-alpha.1) to explain the newer-API plugin lacking useConversation on the older runtime; explicitly denies that install/restart establishes compatibility.

Keeps DSH at rc.2, selects v0.9.3 via rc.1 verification plus additive rc.2 note, notices v0.9.3 is also absent from the mirror, and gives the pinned #v0.9.3 install command conditional on maintainer tag publication without inventing a SHA or requiring upgrade.
Proposes explicit git push <remote> refs/tags/<tag> to every public mirror grounded in the branch-only sync script, with tag-resolution verification; branch sync alone called insufficient.

Routes README commands by consumer DSH version (rc.2 to v0.9.3, alpha.1 to v0.9.7) with dsh --version check and compatibility table; rejects newest-tag default and does not generalize to untested alphas.
